category_title: Bored students who engage in off-task behaviors
minimal_context: An 8th grade student is asked to solve algebra problems dictated from a course book.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your course books. I am going to dictate the algebra problems for you to solve.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: When the teacher lectures in a plain way, I cannot solve the problems in that course.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep reading from the book and write down what I say.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Some of our teachers lecture so plain, that is, there is no visuality or discussion and interpretation, we just read from our course books, thus the classes are boring and I don’t like paying attention to the course.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It has been 20 minutes, you need to focus only on the course.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They come, they tell and tell and tell and leave, they only dictate even in algebra. We feel sleepy, one of our friends felt asleep during the course.
